name: buffett-lesson
caption:
In 1942, at age 11, Warren Buffett made his first investment: 3 shares for $114.75. 💰

He later wrote that if the same $114.75 had gone into an S&P 500 index fund, with all dividends put back in, it would have grown to $606,811 by January 2019. That is the power of time.

The lesson: buy shares in good companies and be patient. People who keep jumping in and out often lose and leave the market.

Source: Warren Buffett, Berkshire Hathaway 2018 shareholder letter, via CNBC, https://www.cnbc.com/2019/02/25/warren-buffett-bought-114point75-in-stock-at-11--what-itd-be-worth-now.html
